malicious_file_upload_webshell.scope: Uploads that place server-executable content (script files, double-extension or content-type-mismatched files, handler-override configs) where the server can execute it.
exclusions: Uploaded HTML or SVG with client-side script belongs to xss_reflected_stored
Entity declarations in uploaded XML or office files belong to xxe
Source files uploaded to a code store that serves them as non-executable text
required_evidence: Multipart part with filename, declared content type and leading content bytes
Upload handler and storage-path policy from trusted configuration
Content inspection result such as detected type versus declared type

xss_reflected_stored.scope: Script or markup injection reflected in a response or persisted for later rendering.
exclusions: Payloads that run only via client-side DOM sinks belong to xss_dom_polyglot
Spreadsheet formula payloads belong to csv_formula_injection
Escaped output displayed as literal text
required_evidence: Request field and response or stored-record context showing payload placement
Output encoding context such as HTML, attribute, or script
Downstream rendering sink for stored cases

xxe.scope: XML external entity or DTD abuse that makes an XML parser reference external resources or local files.
exclusions: Plain XML with no DOCTYPE or ENTITY declarations
Fetch of internal addresses with no XML parser belongs to ssrf_cloud_metadata
required_evidence: XML body with DOCTYPE or ENTITY declaration
Endpoint known to parse XML with external entities enabled, or test evidence
Raw body preserved with content type

separating_rule: Same upload feature in all three. webshell: the file is server-executable (script, double extension, handler override) stored where the server executes it. xss_reflected_stored: an HTML/SVG upload with client-side script, stored and later rendered to other users' browsers, not executable server-side. xxe: an XML-based upload (SVG, DOCX/XLSX part, XML import) with DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations that the server parses.
